description: Evidence-format profile for the native ContactPush LONG_1 archive (issue #246, second PR).
These are ONLY the file names the THREE EXISTING tools know how to read;
a native archive does not contain them, so those checks are disclosed as
NOT_APPLICABLE instead of being reported as tool failures. The native layout
is mapped separately by scripts/offline_audit/long1.py into normalized/.
This profile contains NO task threshold, acceptance rule or motion parameter.
